dct_title_s: Land Cover Areas (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This layer is a vector-based land cover display of 19 classes of geomorphic landforms, surface features and soil types. The layer describes land cover and landscape feature areas (sand, gravel, bog, beach, dune, marsh, snow field, salt pan, yardang, etc..) throughout China.

Purpose: This data is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers. The data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software for natural resource evaluation and monitoring, land use planning, and environmental management and impact analysis, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
